props.name: children
props.description: The content of the tooltip.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position of the tooltip relative to the trigger.

props.name: variant
props.description: Deprecated legacy visual variant. Spectrum 2 tooltips use a single neutral treatment.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Backward-compatible arrow toggle. Spectrum 2 tooltips render an arrow by default.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: dir
props.description: The text direction.

props.name: lang
props.description: The element language.

props.name: id
props.description: The element id.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of an element that describes the tooltip.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: ID of an element that provides details for the tooltip.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Custom aria-label for the tooltip.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of an element that labels the tooltip.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the tooltip should be disabled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the tooltip is open by default (uncontrolled).

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the tooltip is open (controlled).

props.name: containerPadding
props.description: The placement padding between the tooltip and viewport edge.

props.name: offset
props.description: The offset between the tooltip and trigger.

props.name: crossOffset
props.description: The additional offset along the cross axis.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether the tooltip should flip when there is insufficient room.

props.name: arrowSize
props.description: The arrow size used to keep the arrow overlapping the trigger.

props.name: arrowBoundaryOffset
props.description: The padding between the arrow and tooltip edge.

props.name: isEntering

props.name: isExiting
props.description: Whether the tooltip is currently exiting (for animations).
